2123672734899257667.en_summary: Daniel Koss explains market crash due to historic record leverage in AI trade ($NVDA $MU $SOXL $TQQQ), with US margin debt at $1.50T in June 2026 still $1.45T end October. Tiny correction amplified by forced selling and liquidations from stop losses and margin calls. Potential triggers include inflation, rate hikes, Iran, or issues at $CRWV $NBIS $ORCL and Jensen leaving $NVDA.
2123672734899257667.zh_summary: Daniel Koss 解釋市場崩潰源於 AI 交易（$NVDA $MU $SOXL $TQQQ）的歷史紀錄槓桿，美國保證金債務在 2026 年 6 月達 1.50 兆美元，10 月底仍為 1.45 兆。微小修正被止損和保證金追繳引起的強制賣出與清算放大。潛在觸發因素包括通脹、加息、伊朗，或 $CRWV $NBIS $ORCL 問題及 Jensen 離開 $NVDA。

2123670673557991657.en_summary: Mizuho sees ASICs closing the performance gap with GPUs especially in inference. TPU7x approaching NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 on cost/interactivity, better vs MI355X and B300 at mid-to-high interactivity. OAI Jalapeño could have 2.1-4.1x higher performance on interactive workloads vs Blackwell and TPU v7x. GPUs retain advantages in programmability and training but inference may shift to workload-optimized ASICs. Mentions $NVDA $AMD $GOOGL $META.
2123670673557991657.zh_summary: Mizuho 認為 ASIC 正在縮小與 GPU 的性能差距，尤其是推理性能。TPU7x 在成本/互動性前沿接近 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72，在中高互動性上優於 MI355X 和 B300。OAI Jalapeño 在高互動工作負載上可能比 Blackwell 和 TPU v7x 高 2.1-4.1 倍性能。GPU 在可編程性和訓練上保留優勢，但推理可能轉向工作負載優化的 ASIC。提及 $NVDA $AMD $GOOGL $META。

2123669860811252018.en_summary: $SMH has erased almost all gains since the massive gap up on April 8th and is coming back to possibly fill a gap left behind. The chart makes it feel like AI is a hoax.
2123669860811252018.zh_summary: $SMH 已抹去自 4 月 8 日巨大跳空高開以來幾乎所有漲幅，正可能回補留下的缺口。這張圖表讓人覺得 AI 像是騙局。

2123667878264123534.en_summary: Analysis of Intuit fiscal Q1 2027 earnings: QuickBooks 20% online ecosystem growth, 41% mid-market, 33% payment-volume growth show AI reinforcing the platform, while Credit Karma engagement weak. Widening separation between firms controlling transactions/records vs discovery/referrals. Negative read-through for H&R Block (HRB) on assisted tax prep economics due to AI hybrid Sign and File; positive for established accounting platforms. Mentions ~14M assisted filers switching annually, 1/3 for price.
2123667878264123534.zh_summary: Intuit 2027 財年第一季盈利分析：QuickBooks 線上生態系統增長 20%、中市場 41%、支付量 33%，顯示 AI 強化平台，而 Credit Karma 參與度弱。控制交易/記錄的公司與依賴發現/推薦的公司差距擴大。對 H&R Block (HRB) assisted 稅務準備經濟有負面影響，因 AI 混合 Sign and File；對 established 會計平台正面。提及約 1400 萬 assisted filers 每年轉換，1/3 因價格。

ticker_notes.HRB: AI hybrid service pressures assisted prep pricing
